brief: Acid lab-lime index reversed out of a near-black thesis, every project a logged experiment in mono.
rationale:
The hero phrase is a claim — "Every project started as an experiment" — lifted from the portfolio's own "Experiment" category and Doug's register. A claim needs evidence in the same frame, so the composition is a two-asymmetric split: the stacked phrase bound to the left edge on a near-black thesis field, the work index (2008 to 2026, titles and years and roles) outweighing it on the right as proof. That is why symmetry goes right-weighted and the hero object is the list, not the statement: the index is the biggest thing on the page and the phrase is its standfirst.

Space Mono carries the index because the evidence is literally a logged series of code experiments by a developer; mono here is the honest register of a terminal listing, not costume shorthand, and its true italics let the standfirst lead in small-caps italic while the titles stay roman and heavy. The palette answers the word "experiment": acid lab-lime at 98° against a green-tinted near-black, reagent green on a dark field, which also lands ≥60° off the recent gold cluster the repetition check flagged. Split-field is the ground because the composition already is one: the dark thesis plane and the paper catalog are two grounds that need each other.

Layout holds a single left rail per column, caps the measure at 68ch, spends the middle of the scale with a role line and tabular year on every index row, and keeps the mark in the first fold folded into the hero's top on the dark field where the white disc carries. Motion is a quiet settle with on-scroll reveal down the index, so the catalog assembles as you read. At 360 the split stacks: the acid phrase leads, the full-width index follows, and the claim-and-proof relationship survives by adjacency.

hero.copy: Every project started as an experiment.
hero.rationale: Lifted from the portfolio's own framing: the work index labels TeeTurn, Politweets and Twittertale (2008) as "Experiment," and Doug's voice calls his side builds experiments ("the scorecard is the first experiment"). Read over a work index that runs 2008 to 2026, the line is a claim and the index is the proof: Spaceman, FishSticks, 15th Club all began as something he was poking at. It breaks the two-day composed streak cleanly and stays squarely about the work, not the machine. Owner's voice: Doug says what a thing is in plain words, and he'd stand over seven years of side projects and call each one an experiment before he'd call it a product.

adBrief.visualSpecification:
**1. Color Specification**
- Primary hue: 98° (lab lime). Chosen against the mandate's warm 40–80° target because the repetition check demands ≥60° off the 46–50° cluster and because "experiment" wants a reagent/terminal green, not another gold. 98° sits in the one open band (80–128°) the forbidden zones leave.
- Neutral palette (sage, green-tinted): 50 #f6f8f0, 100 #edf0e4, 200 #dce1cf, 300 #c2c9b0, 400 #99a287, 500 #727b62, 600 #545d45, 700 #39402e, 800 #22281b, 900 #131810
- Accent color (lime): light #addb68, default #3f7a19, dark #305d15, glow #addb68
- Secondary accent: none (one accent, two registers)
- Background: page bg #f6f8f0 (paper index); thesis field #131810 (near-black); callout band bgAlt #e4f2cb (pale lime)
- Text colors: primary #131810, secondary #545d45, muted #727b62; on the dark field, ink #f6f8f0 and muted #99a287

**2. Typography**
- Hero phrase rendering: `display` (Space Mono) at ramp step `3xl`→`4xl`, set small-caps italic, stacked one word per line flush-left down the thesis field in `fieldInk`, with the last line EXPERIMENT in `accentAlt` acid lime. It is the standfirst; the work index is the marquee.
- Type treatment: index project titles (the list object) set `hero`-adjacent via the MEASURABLES clamp, Space Mono 700 roman small-caps, one per ruled row. Mid-register: each row carries a `lede`/`md` role line (Archivo) and a `sm` year in tabular figures, so the scale never jumps title-to-caption. Body/roles in Archivo at `base`, 60–68ch, leading 1.5. Micro labels at `xs` in `textFaint`.

**3. Layout Specification**
- Composition: two-asymmetric / vertical / right-weighted / edge-bound / crowded / even / folded-into-hero / balanced / stack / list. The thesis (phrase) binds to the left edge on the dark field; the evidence (index) outweighs it on the right. The phrase claims, the index proves.
- Grid: `display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(360px, 0.72fr) 1.4fr; gap: 0`. Left = thesis field (full-bleed near-black). Right = paper index.
- Major dimensions: hero row `min-height: 100vh` across both columns; thesis column flooded edge to edge; index rows `min-height: clamp(96px, 11vh, 140px)` each. Max content width: `none`; side padding `clamp(40px, 5vw, 96px)` on the paper column, `clamp(32px, 4vw, 72px)` on the field. Section interval one even unit throughout.
- Nav placement: folded into the hero's top row. Horizontal lockup (mark + "Doug March", role beneath) top-left on the dark field; a single mono word "Index" top-right reveals work / about / contact.
- Hero phrase grid zone: left column, rows 1–6 of the thesis field (the stacked phrase), roughly 42vw × 72vh, acid word anchoring the bottom of the stack.
- Home callout slot: `<SiteCallout />` sits on `/` below the work index band and above the baseline identity row, between Selected Work and the footer line, full width, on `bgAlt` pale lime.

**4. Component Character**
- Border radius: cards/rows 0, tags `sm` (2px), buttons `sm`. Sharp, specimen-flat.
- Border treatment: hairline `border` between index rows; `borderStrong` (deep lime) above section breaks and the first/last index rule.
- Shadow: none. Depth is value (dark field vs paper), not elevation.
- Density: crowded but ruled — a dense catalog on a strict even interval.
- Interactive states: row hover floods `surface` and underlines the title in `accent`; the "Index" word reveals the three links on hover/focus.

**5. Signal Integration**
- Signal elements live in a ruled strip at the foot of the paper index, mono tabular, under one `borderStrong` rule.
- Golf: "Austin Championship · Final · Chad Ramey −20" in Space Mono tabular figures, the −20 in `accent`.
- Market: "SPY 739.95 ▼1.91%" tabular, the drop in `textMuted` (no alarm color; a quiet down day).
- Lions: "Lions 35–10" one tabular cell; not the hero (yesterday's).
- Weather/moon: "Aldie VA · 45°F sunny · first quarter" in `textFaint`.
- Music: a single mono line below the strip, "On rotation: The War on Drugs, My Morning Jacket, Tobin Sprout," labeled as taste, not an event.
- Quote (Lennon): not used; the content-lifted line is the hero.
adBrief.selfCheck:
1. Hero quotability: Yes — "Every project started as an experiment" is a maker's ethos that stands alone and frames the index.
2. Because-of chain: Yes — a claim-plus-proof line drove list object → thesis/evidence two-asymmetric split → mono specimen chassis → acid lab-lime on near-black.
3. Render feasibility: Yes — titles at clamp(52px,8vw,120px) in the right column, phrase stacked at 3xl–4xl in the left; both clear 1440 without overflow.
4. Canvas floor feasible: Yes — a crowded ruled index plus a full-height dark thesis field fills 82%.
5. Phone: Yes — stacked 3xl phrase on the dark field leads the first fold at 360, index follows.

adBrief.compositionRationale: The phrase is a thesis that needs its evidence in view, so a two-asymmetric split carries it: the stacked claim bound to the left edge, the work index outweighing it on the right. I moved symmetry onto the soft-forbidden right-weighted deliberately — a list-led page where the index is the proof must let the evidence column dominate, or the claim floats unbacked. Axis stays vertical (the eye travels down the ruled rows), density crowded and rhythm even hold the catalog on one strict interval, matching the mandate's starting read while columns, hero_zone and shell move off it.

colorScheme.color_story: Acid lab-lime against a near-black thesis field reads like a terminal listing of experiments logged over eighteen years.

shell.footer: baseline identity row — one mono line below the index (Doug March, Ashburn VA, 2026, contact), textFaint small-caps, a single borderStrong rule above, no field reversal, no tabular score strip

header.nav: Folded into the hero's top row on the near-black thesis field: horizontal lockup (mark + "Doug March", role beneath) at top-left where the white disc carries easily; a single mono word "Index" at top-right in small-caps that reveals work / about / contact. Mark inside the first fold at 1440 and 360.

1. (Judgment 5) Several index descriptions contradict the work records. "Operations tooling, shipped as a product after it solved its own problem" is wrong: FishSticks is a spelling-practice app that imports school word-list PDFs for kids. "Tee-time logistics, prototyped over a weekend" is wrong: TeeTurn is a mobile-first golf app for tracking a round in real time, where Doug handled product direction and strategy. "A story stitched from tweets" is wrong: Twittertale scanned public tweets for swear words and ranked users, and it was covered by Mashable.

2. (Judgment 5) The Spaceman entry invents its premise and its line "The company it grew into." The records say Spaceman is Doug's LLC for independent design and engineering work with clients such as Zeldman, Rolex and Intuit, and that its problem is independent work that doesn't fit inside a company. Replace "Solo founders carry a back office… billing, docs" with the recorded text. The role line "Designer & Engineer" must also read "Product Designer & Developer," as identity.role states.

3. (Judgment 1) Tonight repeats 2026-11-09 on too many traits. Both are two-asymmetric, vertical, folded-into-hero, balanced split-field pages with small-caps type, and tonight's 98° lime on a near-black field sits 4° from that night's 94° olive brass. It also shares the Space Mono/Archivo chassis, the italic lead and the same silhouette with 2026-11-04. Move the hue well off the 94° band, or change the ground or the silhouette, so a returning visitor cannot mistake it for 11-09.

4. (Judgment 2) In fold 3 at 360, a grey bar and box sit over the Spaceman row. They cover the "Founder" tag, the "Problem" label and the start of "had the first time around," and the line is cut mid-word. Remove the stray layer so that copy reads cleanly.

1. (Judgment 1) As rendered, tonight reruns 2026-11-09 and 2026-11-04. It shares 11-09's two-asymmetric vertical split, folded-into-hero shell, balanced field, split-field ground, small-caps register and a green near 94°, and 11-04's Space Mono/Archivo split. The thesis field also shows as mid forest green instead of the declared near-black #131810, which makes the overlap worse. Paint the field #131810 and the index ground paper #f6f8f0 as specified, so the page reads as acid lime on near-black rather than another green split.
2. (Judgment 4) At 360, fold 1 sets the stacked phrase well under the declared `hero_step_360: 3xl`. It sits barely above body size in a mostly empty dark field. Bring it up to the 3xl step so the first fold carries the claim the Mobile Declaration names.
3. (Judgment 5) The 15th Club row says "A golf model that began as the scorecard." The record calls it "a platform for AI experiments through the lens of golf," with the scorecard as its first experiment. Replace "golf model" with wording drawn from the record.
4. (Judgment 5) The Spaceman "Problem" callout reads "one place for the client work that lives outside any employer." That is not in the record, and the record says the work is "sometimes embedded in a larger team." Use the record's problem text, which begins "Independent design and engineering work doesn't always fit neatly inside a company…"

[check 2] Colour coverage measured 18.1% at 1440x900 against a declared floor of 42%, 23.9 points under (the margin is 5). Paint more of the first 900px in the day's chromatic tokens (a field, a band, a panel background); near-black, near-white and grey do not count.

1. (Judgment 1, freshness) Tonight reads as a rerun of 2026-11-09. Both pages use a two-asymmetric vertical split-field, with a dark field on the left and a paper column on the right. Tonight's 98° lime on green-black is effectively 11-09's 94° olive brass on the same ground, and the small-caps register repeats it too. The Space Mono/Archivo italic-regular-left chassis also repeats 11-04's chassis on the same split. Move the primary hue well off 94° or change the ground strategy so a returning visitor cannot mistake this for 11-09.

2. (Judgment 3, hierarchy) The lead element is the first index title, "dougmar.ch". It renders as plain lowercase while every other title (FishSticks, 15th Club, TeeTurn) gets small capitals. That breaks the declared `case: small-caps` on the one element that leads. Set it in the same small-caps treatment as the rest of the index.

3. (Judgment 5, copy) The Spaceman "Problem" panel on the phone is not what the record says. It reads: "…and is sometimes embedded in a larger team. Spaceman is the single shingle for the design and engineering Doug takes on directly…"
   - The record's problem statement contains neither sentence.
   - The record's approach says the work is "sometimes as a solo contributor, sometimes embedded in a larger team." The panel's "takes on directly" wording contradicts that.
   
   Quote the record's problem text as written, or drop the panel.

measurables.method: Measured at 1440x900 on a 20px grid over the viewport at scroll position zero. canvas_utilization: % of grid cells touched by an element carrying designed content (visible text, an image/SVG/video/canvas, a background colour distinct from the page background and not transparent, or a background image such as a gradient). A background set on html or body counts as painting the page, unless it is opaque white; ::before and ::after boxes count on the same terms. color_coverage: % of grid cells whose sampled background, background-image stops or text colour is chromatic (HSL saturation > 12%, lightness 8-92%). hero_px: the largest computed font-size among first-fold elements that set visible text.
